summary: Verified backend fix that moved Stripe Tax config into an idempotent startup function ensure_stripe_tax_configured(). Backend restarts cleanly, Stripe Tax stays correctly configured, no duplicate PT registrations are created on repeated restarts, all VAT regression tests pass, and frontend still renders + IVA (23%) labels.
critical_code_review_comments: ensure_stripe_tax_configured() runs 12+ Stripe API calls on every backend startup (~1s latency). Consider caching a 'tax_configured' flag in Mongo to skip on subsequent boots, or gating with an env flag, especially since supervisor + hot-reload restarts backend frequently.
The function is wrapped in try/except (good, non-blocking) but errors are only logged - consider surfacing to a health/status endpoint so ops can detect a mis-configured environment quickly.
server.py is very large (>3300 lines). Startup seed + Stripe tax config would benefit from extraction into backend/services/stripe_tax.py for maintainability.
test_credentials: Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (not exercised in this iteration - Stripe-hosted checkout page VAT display was already verified in iteration_11)
seed_data_creation: None. Verified via Stripe API that exactly 1 active PT tax registration exists (taxreg_1UJSv8ERmwXcLQe4y3AisYnT, type=standard) after multiple backend restarts, and Tax Settings head_office=PT with default tax_code=txcd_20080007.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_11 already verified end-to-end VAT calc on Stripe-hosted checkout in test mode. This iteration_12 only re-verified the startup idempotency of the new ensure_stripe_tax_configured() function and ran the 5 test_stripe_vat.py regression tests (all pass). LIVE mode fix cannot be validated here (no live Stripe key in preview env) - user must redeploy production and confirm.
rca of the issue: Root cause (already known and fixed by main agent): Stripe Test mode and Live mode are separate data namespaces on the same connected account. The prior one-off configuration script (setting Tax Settings head_office, PT Tax Registration, and Product tax_codes) was only executed against the TEST key, so LIVE checkout sessions had no tax registration and Stripe returned Imposto=0. Fix: idempotent ensure_stripe_tax_configured() invoked from @app.on_event('startup') so whichever STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (test or live) is active gets configured on every deploy. Verified: repeated restarts do not create duplicate PT registrations (still exactly 1 active), no startup crash, no error logs, all Stripe calls return 200.
